title: Classical Control Theory
description:
Prerequisite: ENMT301.
Restriction: Only open to students enrolled in the Mechatronics Engineering degree program at the Universities of Shady Grove. An introduction to the feedback control of dynamic systems. Laplace transforms and transfer function techniques; frequency response and Bode diagrams. Stability analysis via root locus and Nyquist techniques. Performance specifications in time and frequency domains, and design of compensation strategies to meet performance goals.
